name: BuildABand
author: belgiumwebnetinc

sections.description:
Demo | Pro Version

BuildABand is a fully customizable wedding band builder with real-time preview and live ring updates. Customers can personalize rings by selecting profile, metal, color, width (mm), finish, and thickness. The app offers a smooth, mobile-friendly experience, quick setup, and easy integration. Ideal for jewelers and WordPress merchants aiming to boost engagement, increase conversions, and deliver personalized shopping.

Features

  • Personalize bands with attributes like profile, metal type, and color.
  • Adjust width (mm) and thickness to achieve the perfect fit and style.
  • Add custom finishes to enhance the band’s texture and final look.
  • Preview band designs in real time for a seamless shopping experience.
  • Add your custom band directly to cart and proceed to WordPress checkout.

Note: This demo of the BuildABand plugin uses dummy data for demonstration purposes only. To integrate real Band feed data into your WordPress site, please upgrade to our Pro version by purchasing a paid plan.

sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the buildaband.zip file.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Add the shortcode [BuildABand] to any page.
sections.faq:
How do I display the builder on my page?

Use the shortcode [BuildABand] anywhere you want the builder to appear.

Can I customize the look and feel of the design?

Yes, you can customize the styles by editing the CSS file located in the assets/css/ folder.
